chunks: Zurʿah narrated from Samāʿah, who said:

I asked him about the divorce of a young boy who has not yet had a wet dream, and about his charity. He said: "If he divorces according to the sunnah and places the charity in its proper place and due right, then there is no harm, and it is valid."

key_terms.الْغُلَامِ: a young boy who has not yet reached maturity
key_terms.حَقِّهَا: its due entitlement or proper right
key_terms.طَلَاقِ: divorce as a legal act dissolving marriage
key_terms.لِلسُّنَّةِ: in accordance with the sunnah-prescribed manner
key_terms.مَوْضِعِهَا: its proper place or rightful recipient
key_terms.يَحْتَلِمْ: to experience a wet dream, indicating puberty

ai.seo_question: Is the divorce or charity of a boy who has not yet reached puberty valid in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the acts of a young boy who has not yet reached puberty, specifically divorce and charity. It indicates that if these acts are carried out properly according to the sunnah and in their rightful manner, they are considered valid.
